en.t: Empress Mother Fujitsubo also came to the palace.

units.source_text: 前斋宫入宫之夜，冷泉帝听说有个新女御要来了，

en.t: On the night when the former Ise priestess entered the palace, Emperor Reizei heard that a new consort was coming,

units.source_text: 颇感兴味，提起了精神等候着。

en.t: and he became quite interested, brightened up, and waited for her.

units.source_text: 就年龄而论，冷泉帝是个非常懂事而老成的人。

en.t: For his age, Emperor Reizei was remarkably sensible and mature.

units.source_text: 不过藤壶母后还是告诫他道：“有一个优秀的女御来陪伴你了，你要好好地对待她啊！”

en.t: Even so, Empress Mother Fujitsubo admonished him, saying, "An excellent consort is coming to keep you company, so you must treat her well."

units.source_text: 冷泉帝想：“和大人做伴，也许是很难为情的吧？”

en.t: Emperor Reizei thought, "Being with a grown-up may be rather embarrassing."

units.source_text: 到了十分夜深的时候，新女御才进宫来。

en.t: Only when the night had grown very late did the new consort finally come to the palace.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝一看，这个人生得身材小巧，容貌温雅，举止端详，实在非常可爱，

en.t: When Emperor Reizei looked at her, he saw that she was petite, gentle in appearance, and composed in manner, truly very lovely,

units.source_text: 他和弘徽殿女御已经伴熟，认为这个人可亲可爱，无须顾忌。

en.t: He had already grown used to the Kokiden consort and found her warm and lovable, with no need for reserve.

units.source_text: 现在这个新女御呢，态度庄重，令人起敬。

en.t: This new consort, however, had a dignified bearing that inspired respect.

units.source_text: 加之源氏内大臣对她十分重视，照顾优厚，因此冷泉帝觉得对她不可怠慢。

en.t: Moreover, since the Inner Minister Genji valued her highly and looked after her with great care, Emperor Reizei felt he could not treat her lightly.

units.source_text: 晚上侍寝，由两女御轮流值班。

en.t: At night, the two consorts took turns attending him in his bedchamber.

units.source_text: 白昼欲随意不拘地玩耍，则大都往弘徽殿女御那里去。

en.t: During the day, when he wanted to play freely and without formality, he usually went to the Kokiden consort.

units.source_text: 权中纳言遣女儿入宫，原是希望她将来立为皇后的。

en.t: The Provisional Middle Counselor had sent his daughter into the palace because he hoped she would one day be made empress.

units.source_text: 现在又来了这前斋宫，和他女儿相竞争，他心中便觉多方不安。

en.t: Now that this former Ise priestess had also arrived to compete with his daughter, he felt uneasy in many ways.
